name: Crossy Crosshair — Stylish PvP Crosshair
summary: A stylish crosshair variant for players who want a different look in PvP.
body:
> **📌 Consolidated:** this crosshair is now part of the **[Dot Crosshair](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/dot-crosshair-cossx-better-crosshair)** flagship — get the latest version there.

Replaces the default Minecraft crosshair with a cleaner, sharper design.

**Compatible with all versions** (1.11 → latest) and works on every launcher.
Just drop the pack in your `resourcepacks` folder and enable it — no Optifine required.
Perfect for PvP, survival and bow aim.

---

Part of the **CrossX series**. Original & most popular: [Dot Crosshair](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/dot-crosshair-cossx-better-crosshair)
